title: The case returned without its lock
body: The briefcase is open; the screwdriver rests across its clasp. Fresh metal shows where the lock was forced, and the paper tag has been scraped blank.
rival_reading: A technician protecting program materials could force an old case and remove a destination tag during routine inventory; this does not by itself prove a cover-up.
gloss: A forced case and erased destination tag suggest someone reopened a record or its contents.

title: Seed kept inside the fertilizer bag
body: A torn seed packet is folded into the fertilizer bag’s sealed edge. Pencil marks show a scoop removed, then the instruction beside it crossed out.
rival_reading: A county crew could inventory farm supplies after a road restriction; a missing scoop and folded seed packet do not prove the program malfunctioned.
gloss: A seed packet and a used fertilizer bag remain together with an altered handling note.
